oneOf.description: One segment of a print this system watched, on one tool.

segment.description:
Which segment: zero from the print's start, and one more each time
a mid-print swap or a filament-change signal closes the current one.

tool.description: The tool, in the printer's own numbering.

oneOf.description: One print this system never saw, on one tool.

generation.description:
The file's tally generation, which advances each time the printer's
tally for the file is reset.

origin.description: Where the file lives, in the printer's own vocabulary.

print_number.description:
The print's ordinal in the file's tally — completed and failed
prints counted up to and including this one — within that
generation.

tool.description: The tool, in the printer's own numbering.

ChargeMethod.description: How the length a charge debits was worked out.

oneOf.description: A completed print: the length the file's analysis gives.
The extrusion the file's own moves add up to, up to a position in it.

The analysed length scaled by how far into the file the print got; the
fallback used only when the file itself could not be read.
A completed print this system never saw: the file's analysed length.

ChargedFilament.description:
What a charge took from a spool, and the whole calculation behind it.

Present or absent as one: a debit names its spool exactly when it carries
the grams, the figures they were worked out with, and the spool's figure
either side of them.

density_g_cm3.description:
The density the grams were worked out with, in grams per cubic
centimetre.

diameter_mm.description: The diameter the grams were worked out with, in millimetres.

grams.description: What the length weighs, in grams; what is subtracted from the spool.

remaining_after_g.description: The spool's figure after it, in grams.

remaining_before_g.description: The spool's figure before the charge, in grams.

FilePosition.description: How far into its file a print had got, and when that was read.

bytes.description: The byte the printer had read the file up to.

size_bytes.description: The file's size in bytes, when it was known.
